research_question: 已有研究通过哪些机制把显式知识从可检索内容转化为 Agent 的行动引导、约束、修复或经验复用，这些工作为第二章留下的可防守边界是什么？

sources.title: CangLing-KnowFlow: A Unified Knowledge-and-Flow-fused Agent for Comprehensive Remote Sensing Applications
KnowAgent: Knowledge-Augmented Planning for LLM-Based Agents
Ontology-to-tools compilation for executable semantic constraint enforcement in LLM agents
ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners

claims.text: CangLing-KnowFlow 将遥感专家程序知识表示为工具 schema 与层次化工作流模板，并以执行反馈触发图结构修复；任务后又把成功调整固化为带情境元数据的模板，把终止失败归纳为条件式 Pattern-Action 修复规则。
KnowAgent 将 action knowledge 定义为动作集合及其允许的转移规则，以文本化知识约束规划路径；其知识构造包含领域专家提供任务知识、LLM 初拟、人工筛选修订与再次生成规则。
Ontology-to-tools 工作把本体约束编译为 Agent 必须调用的工具接口，在创建知识图谱实例时检查类型、单位和必需字段，并以结构化错误反馈驱动修复，而不是只做事后校验。
ExpeL 从成功与失败轨迹的比较以及跨任务成功轨迹中抽取自然语言 insight，并在推理时同时复用这些 insight 与相似成功轨迹；作者也报告反思文本可能产生幻觉并误导 insight 抽取。
这四项研究表明，知识进入 Agent 行为至少可通过工作流模板、动作转移规则、可执行工具约束和经验 insight 四种机制；但它们不能单独证明任务条件化的科学适用性、证据状态、禁止性推断与结论降级已经得到解决。第二章可据此收窄为知识和证据如何产生可审计的科学行动义务，而不应泛称首次把专家知识注入 Agent。

links.note: The paper evaluates generic deterministic interactive tasks; environment success is not scientific evidence, and extracted insights can be misleading.
Direct remote-sensing comparator for procedural workflows, execution repair, and experience memory; absence of the Chapter 2 epistemic interface is a positioning inference, not a source claim.
Action-transition constraints demonstrate that expert knowledge injection is already occupied as a generic planning contribution.
Executable compilation is a useful adjacent mechanism, but Chapter 2 lacks the formal ontology and enforcement guarantees needed to claim compilation.
Experience reuse motivates a future extension, but feedback-derived strategy must remain quarantined from scientific evidence status.
